decisions.slice: I-4-4C3 (tracker #60): the receipt-aware materialize_test_verdict_artifact.py and its source tests. The script is moved verbatim; no wrapper, schema or policy is added.
decisions.reuse: The materializer loads scripts/agent-guards/controlled_skill_mutation_exec.py by path (_CONTROLLED_EXEC_PATH) and reuses its _validate_test_verdict_publish_fields, _verify_producer_run_and_job, _verify_execution_artifact_metadata and _download_and_verify_artifact_archive (plus _find_gh_bin / _build_pr_review_gh_env). The source test drives adjudicate_vc_result.py (I-4-4B1). None of them is copied or changed.
decisions.no_publish: test_verdict.publish is neither called nor enabled. The materializer has no subprocess import and no gh/git argv of its own: every GitHub read goes through the reused executor functions, and the source tests replace gh with a fake subprocess.
decisions.local_writes: The materializer writes the local input/private bundle atomically and, when blocked, invalidates (unlinks) stale files at the caller-given output paths. The tests only use tmp_path, never a user artifact.
decisions.evidence: Fake gh and real zip bytes built in the test; this is not a real GitHub readback and not a Final Gate result.
